row.notes: mov rax,[rbp-8] in Sess_MarshalLights_AssignToZones (+0x197), 4 bytes, then mov r13,rbp; add r13,-8; vmovss [rax+0x34],xmm7 (+0x1a2); cmp r13,[rsi+0x68]; je +0x4a8. The step of the back-to-front walk over the light list (rsi = MarshalLightsSystem, list begin [rsi+0x68], end [rsi+0x70]): reached by jmp from +0x4a3 after a light got a zone (rbp = r13, one past it) and by fall-through after a light in no zone was erased (memmove at +0x18d, end -= 8 at +0x192, rbp = the erased light's slot). It loads the light before rbp and stores the walk's lap fraction (xmm7) at its +0x34. When the erased light was the first one, rbp == [rsi+0x68] and [rbp-8] is the 8 bytes before the list's block: 0 in all three crash reports (ACCESS_VIOLATION writing 0x34 at +0x1a2, F1_25.exe+0x2c794d2 on Steam 26566308, rbp = list begin, 7 lights left, capacity 42); a non-zero value would be written to and the walk would go on below the list (r13 = begin-8 never equals begin). No branch lands in +0x198..+0x19d.
